faqs.network_explanation: A blockchain network is a public ledger system that records who owns what tokens and all transfers. Ethereum, BSC, and Polygon are different ledgers, each independent and separate.
faqs.wallet_explanation: A Web3 wallet isn't where money is stored - it's the key to manage your blockchain account. Your funds are recorded on the blockchain ledger, and the wallet proves you own the account. Popular: MetaMask, Coinbase Smart Wallet.
faqs.native_token_explanation: Native tokens are used to pay miners who process your transactions. Ethereum uses ETH, BSC uses BNB, Polygon uses POL. Miners record your transaction on the blockchain ledger, and you pay them this fee.
faqs.eip7702_explanation: Tech that temporarily upgrades regular wallets to smart contract wallets during a transaction. No extra deployment needed.
faqs.why_need_eip7702_explanation: Lets wallets with no gas money send tokens. Your main wallet pays gas for them, enabling one-click sweep.
faqs.create2_proxy_explanation: Deployment tool ensuring same contract address across all chains. Same code = same address everywhere.
faqs.multicall3_explanation: Batches multiple calls into one. Saves gas and time. All-or-nothing execution.
faqs.biubiu_premium_explanation: Membership contract managing subscriptions, discounts, and access. Fully open source.
faqs.wallet_sweep_explanation: Core contract for batch transfers. Handles EIP-7702 delegation and approvals. Open source: https://github.com/atshelchin/biubiu-contracts
faqs.can_select_multiple_tokens: Can I select multiple tokens at once?
faqs.can_select_multiple_tokens_explanation: Yes! You can select as many tokens as you want. The tool will sweep all selected tokens in one batch operation, making it very efficient.
faqs.what_happens_zero_balance: What happens if a wallet has zero balance for a token?
faqs.what_happens_zero_balance_explanation: Smart! The system automatically skips wallets with zero balance for that specific token. This saves you gas costs by not executing unnecessary transfers.
faqs.what_tokens_supported: What types of tokens are supported?
faqs.what_tokens_supported_explanation: We support both native tokens (like ETH on Ethereum, BNB on BSC, MATIC on Polygon) and all ERC-20 standard tokens. Most tokens you encounter will work.
faqs.how_add_custom_token: How do I add a custom token?
faqs.how_add_custom_token_explanation: Click the '+ Add Token' button, then enter the token's contract address. The system will automatically fetch the token's name, symbol, and decimals from the blockchain.

seo.page_title: Wallet Sweep - Consolidate Tokens from Multiple Wallets | BiuBiu Tools
seo.page_description: Consolidate tokens from multiple wallets to a single destination. Support for Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base networks. Fast, secure, and gas-optimized.
seo.keywords: wallet sweep, token consolidation, ERC20 transfer, batch transfer, crypto tools, web3 tools, ethereum tools, polygon tools, DeFi tools
seo.webapp_description: Consolidate tokens from multiple wallets to a single destination. Support for Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base networks.
seo.feature_2: Multi-network support (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base)
seo.howto_name: How to Consolidate Tokens from Multiple Wallets with Wallet Sweep
seo.howto_description: Step-by-step guide to consolidate tokens from multiple wallets to a single destination using BiuBiu Wallet Sweep tool.
seo.step_1_text: Click the "Connect Wallet" button and select your preferred Web3 wallet provider (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, etc.). Approve the connection request in your wallet.
seo.step_2_text: Verify the blockchain network connection and ensure all required smart contracts are accessible. The system will automatically detect and validate the necessary components.
seo.step_3_text: Choose which ERC20 tokens you want to sweep from the available list. You can select multiple tokens to transfer in a single batch operation.
seo.step_4_text: Import the source wallet addresses that contain the tokens you want to sweep. You can add multiple wallet addresses to collect tokens from all of them.
seo.step_5_text: Review the transaction summary including total tokens, gas fees, and destination address. Click "Execute Transfer" and confirm the transaction in your wallet. Wait for blockchain confirmation and view the transaction receipt.
